pr_body:
In order to make inserts work, a few fixes were needed in various helper functions. See the individual commits.

The most extensive change in this PR is a switch from using `string` to `tree.Name` for all variables that store a column name. This addresses issues with needing to double-quote certain column name identifiers.

fixes #127263
Release note: None
